messages:
Aisha K.: Noticed a cluster of unassigned leads this morning when enrichment API slowed. SLA alerts tripped. Quick check: our RR waits for enrichment before assigning — can we flip to a temp assign + reconcile?

Marco T.: Yep, saw ~95 unowned leads between 07:10-07:40 UTC. Third-party enrichment retries caused delay. Temp assign would reduce open-window but we need guardrails to avoid owner overwrite after SDR touch.

Priya S.: Proposed pattern: temp RR owner immediately, mark assignment_source=temp. If enrichment returns and lead.last_touch==null -> set owner=enrichment_owner and assignment_source=final. If last_touch!=null -> set reconciliation_flag and notify sales-ops.

Aisha K.: SLA language for playbook: acknowledge <=20s, temp_assign <15s, final_owner settle <=4m. Owner flip rate >1.5% over 24h should trigger rollback plan.

hubspot-bot: Deployed hs/temp-assign-v1 to staging. Run test payloads and report metrics: time_to_temp_assign, time_to_final_assign, percent_unowned_30s, owner_flip_count.

Marco T.: Running 1k synthetic leads now. Will capture metrics and check SFDC sync so it doesn't overwrite human-updated owners.

Priya S.: Also adding a small audit trail prop (reconciliation_history) so sales-ops can review flips. Drafting an email template for SDRs when reconciliation_flag=true.

Aisha K.: Perfect. If staging looks stable we'll canary next Tuesday 20% -> 100% over 48h. Thanks all.
